deskyard remote remove: forget a remote

Usage: deskyard [-e NAME] remote remove NAME

Removes a saved remote (the token itself stays valid until someone revokes it
on the Remote access tab).

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  remote name

Prints: nothing

Examples:
  deskyard remote remove alice

Where: on this machine (no remote needed)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
